name: After § 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text: 7a. Calls on the Commission to cease all EU macro-financial assistance, budget support and any other financial aid to Moldova; insists that EU taxpayers must not be compelled to subsidise persistent governance failures abroad and that EU tax revenues must be used first and foremost for the benefit of EU citizens;
